ops.body:
CGO=0 route proof (Recommended)
Question: #44175 (green on dev) dropped the -o and GO_REMOTE requirements, but the shim still runs any build where `go env CGO_ENABLED` is not 0 on the real local go. This Mac defaults to 1 (clang is present), so the recorded failing command, a plain `go build .` in go/ci, would still compile locally, and I haven't run it. How should I verify Go?
Options: CGO=0 route proof (Recommended) | Fetch + status only | Default-CGO candidate first | Record limit, stop Go
